name: ashlar
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: INDIVIDUAL MODULAR STONE PIECE to be reconstructed as a Meshy 3D game model and assembled with many other pieces into a tropical ruined temple. Premium modern stylized platformer environment art, sculpted low-poly geometry with deliberate broad bevels and tactile volume. Muted warm limestone/sage-grey stone, warm pale worn bevels, deeper cool grey recesses; small sparse moss patches confined to a few corners. Broad hand-painted tonal planes, restrained texture, no noisy scratches or photorealistic grit. The design should look convincing from all sides. Isolated ONE object centered on neutral light grey background, no ground plane or shadow catcher, no scenery, no text, no grid or measurements. Three-quarter orthographic product view showing the top and two sides clearly, full silhouette inside generous margin. Neutral soft studio illumination. One LARGE PLAIN dressed masonry stone block. Proportions exactly 2 wide x 1 high x 1 deep. Broad flat rectangular top, flat broad front, thick chunky side, slightly irregular chamfered edges, 2 corners subtly chipped, one shallow broad surface depression. A finely judged sculpted stone, not a perfect plastic cube, not an ornate carved tile. No symbols or ornament. Straight outer silhouette and mostly flat seating faces, suitable for dry-stacked temple walls. One little moss smear along a bottom corner, not a green cap. Keep the face calm and the bevels beautifully lit.
